title: Jagged Crunchy Moroccan Peanuts Tagine
description: A charred, crunchy, one-pot Moroccan dish featuring peanuts, cooked to perfection on a yakimono-grill, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the peanuts on the grill for 5 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly charred.
Grill the onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes, or until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the grill and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas to the grill and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the toasted peanuts to the grill and stir to combine with the chickpeas and spices.
Reduce heat to medium-low, about 300 degrees Fahrenheit, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
